answer: AI agents trading saffron harvest data and floral nectar futures resist Sybil attacks through slashable collateral deposits. Every new participant must lock capital in escrow before submitting telemetry. An attacker incurs the verifiable financial cost of locked liquidity per identity, losing those funds if caught attempting to forge consensus states. A key limitation is that well-funded adversaries can still lock substantial capital, marginalizing resource-constrained nodes.
